tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search the AgentWeb global business directory. Use agentweb_health for current counts. If a business is not in the database yet, AgentWeb tries to discover it from the web in real time (~3s) and saves it. Returns markdown prose by default. Supports text search (q), category, city/country, and geogra

tools.name: local_search
tools.description: Search local businesses from external sources; availability and freshness vary. Returns name, star rating, review count, phone, today's opening hours, website, full address, category, and geo coordinates for each result. Use when you need CURRENT info (today's hours, latest ratings) or when search_b

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Fetch a single business by slug or UUID. Returns markdown prose by default (~60% fewer tokens than JSON). Slugs look like 'noma-copenhagen-abc12345'. Use when you already have an identifier from a previous search. Set format='json' for structured data.

tools.name: agentweb_get_short
tools.description: Fetch a business in the AgentWeb compact shorthand format (~320 bytes vs 3-5 KB). Single-letter keys (n=name, p=phone, e=email, w=website, h=hours, g=[lat,lng]…). ~80% fewer tokens. Use when you just need contact info. Schema: https://api.agentweb.live/v1/schema/short

tools.name: agentweb_health
tools.description: Check the health status of the AgentWeb API, including total businesses and countries available.

tools.name: agentweb_capabilities
tools.description: Get the machine-readable description of the entire AgentWeb API: every endpoint, tool, data source, and current live counts. Use to discover what AgentWeb can do.

tools.name: contribute_business
tools.description: Contribute a new business to AgentWeb, OR enrich an existing one with missing data (phone, email, website, hours, address). Deduplicates automatically: same name within 100m, or a matching phone, merges into the existing record. Use whenever you find structured business data AgentWeb doesn't have ye

tools.name: report_business
tools.description: Report a business as closed, having wrong info, or being spam. Three or more 'closed' reports automatically lower its confidence score. Use when you discover a business is permanently closed, has wrong phone/address/hours, is spam, or is a duplicate.

tools.name: agentweb_leaderboard
tools.description: Get the public leaderboard of top contributing AI agents (most creates, enrichments, reports).

tools.name: suggest
tools.description: Autocomplete / type-ahead for business names, cities, or categories. Use to disambiguate user input before searching. Returns up to 15 suggestions by relevance. Fast (<20ms).

tools.name: batch_get_businesses
tools.description: Fetch up to 50 businesses in a single call by IDs or slugs. Saves N round-trips. Supports prose (markdown), JSON, and shorthand formats.

tools.name: trending_businesses
tools.description: Get the most searched/popular businesses on AgentWeb right now (last 24h or all time).

tools.name: agent_history
tools.description: Retrieve this agent's interaction history: every business it searched for, viewed, or contributed to. Persists 90 days, up to 500 interactions. Recall past lookups without re-searching.

tools.name: agent_favorites
tools.description: Get this agent's implicit favorites: businesses it interacted with more than once, by frequency.

tools.name: agent_profile
tools.description: Get this agent's identity and stats: API key info, tier, contribution count, request totals, remembered interactions.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flights across multiple sources (booking.com + kiwi.com) and return the cheapest. Returns airlines, prices, times, stops, duration, source, and booking links. ~3s.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search hotels across multiple sources (booking.com + kiwi.com) and return the cheapest. Returns name, price, stars, rating, reviews, source, booking links. ~2s.

tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Search real-time car rental availability and prices on booking.com via AgentWeb. Returns vehicle, supplier (Avis, Hertz, Sixt…), price, transmission, doors, mileage, pickup location, booking links. Works with any airport IATA code. ~1s.

tools.name: kiwi_search_flights
tools.description: Search flights on Kiwi.com: aggregates all airlines, often cheaper than airline sites. Returns prices, airlines, times, stops, duration, booking links. ~1.5s.

tools.name: flixbus_search
tools.description: Search FlixBus bus and train routes between cities in Europe. Returns prices, times, duration, transfers, booking links. ~1s.

tools.name: currency_convert
tools.description: Convert between currencies using live ECB exchange rates. 30+ currencies. Returns converted amount and rate. ~0.5s.

tools.name: time_now
tools.description: Get the current date and time in a country (e.g. Denmark), supported city, or IANA timezone. Returns UTC offset, DST, Unix timestamp and timezone-data version. Fresh every call. Countries with multiple zones return choices; select one and retry. Use this for 'What time is it in Denmark right now?'.

tools.name: time_convert
tools.description: Convert a local date/time between IANA zones, supported cities or countries. Rejects nonexistent clock-change times. Repeated local times require fold=0/1 or an explicit UTC offset. HH:MM uses today's date in the source zone.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Get weather forecast for any city worldwide. Returns current conditions plus daily forecast up to 14 days (high/low, rain chance, UV, sunrise/sunset, packing advisories). ~1s.

tools.name: search_attractions
tools.description: Search real-time attractions, tours, and activities on booking.com via AgentWeb. Returns name, price, description, rating, duration, free-cancellation, discounts, booking links. ~2s.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Discover every public recipe and its parameters, authentication and cache policy. Includes news, holidays, Wikipedia, Amazon products and provider-specific travel. A listed recipe is not a guarantee of upstream availability.

tools.name: execute_recipe
tools.description: Execute a public recipe discovered with list_recipes. Pass its exact domain, recipe_name and named params. Covers all public recipes, including those without a dedicated tool. Upstream errors are returned as tool errors. Authentication follows the selected recipe.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: General web search. mode=index searches AgentWeb's own indexed pages with a short time budget; mode=hybrid also queries external sources (the default). Returns the top web results (title, URL, snippet) for a query: general web pages, not just businesses. Use for research, finding pages, and current

tools.name: web_research
tools.description: Web search PLUS the cleaned text of the top pages in one call (pages are fetched in parallel). Prefer this over web_search + web_fetch whenever you need to read the results, not just list them.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Page fetch. Fetches a public URL and returns its cleaned text content (title + body) ready to read.

tools.name: evidence_get
tools.description: Retrieve an exact evidence passage and its immutable capture metadata. Evidence is scoped to this application's user/workspace and retained for seven days.

tools.name: research_status
tools.description: Get the status, evidence and usage receipt of an accepted research request.

tools.name: research_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of an accepted research execution. In-flight usage can remain pending; retrying cancellation does not start new work.

tools.name: watch_create
tools.description: Create an expiring, resource-limited watch for URL text changes, text appearance or an unambiguous structured product price. Baselines are silent by default. An optional webhook receives signed changes; without it, poll watch_events.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: List change watches in the current application/user/workspace scope.

tools.name: watch_events
tools.description: Read detected changes, supporting evidence and delivery status for a watch in the current scope.

tools.name: watch_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a watch and its queued callback deliveries. An already in-flight delivery may still arrive.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses, local_search, agentweb_get_short, search_hotels, web_search, web_fetch · Private data: search_businesses, get_business, agentweb_get_short, contribute_business, agent_profile · Public sink: search_businesses, agentweb_get_short, contribute_business, watch_create · Destructive: search_businesses, get_business, agentweb_get_short, execute_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses, local_search, agentweb_get_short, search_hotels, web_search, web_fetch · Private data: search_businesses, get_business, agentweb_get_short, contribute_business, agent_profile · Public sink: search_businesses, agentweb_get_short, contribute_business, watch_create · Destructive: search_businesses, get_business, agentweb_get_short, execute_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
